title: Infrastructure Team Lead

additionalInformation.label: GGSS contract award and value history ($275.2 million original ceiling; $545.9 million current base and options)
GOES-R ground system contract (up to $1.833 billion)

description: Led the nine-person GCCS infrastructure team and owned the AWS foundation for migrating capabilities from the GOES-R ground system, developed under a contract valued at up to $1.833 billion, to the cloud. Delivered this work under the GGSS contract, whose original $275.2 million ceiling has since increased to $545.9 million in base and options, while expanding the platform to distribute NOAA SOLAR-1 data.
highlights: Managed nine direct reports and set implementation direction, schedules, and delivery priorities for the GCCS infrastructure team.
Directed completion of the AWS infrastructure required to migrate operational GOES processing from the existing ground system to GCCS.
Expanded the cloud platform to support distribution of real-time SOLAR-1 space-weather data alongside GOES products.
Supported the formal transition of GCCS into operations and the Service Transition Readiness Review completed on June 24, 2026.
